title: I Hate Love PDF: 45-in-1 Client-Side PDF Suite
tagline: Zero-upload client-side PDF manipulation engine powered by WebAssembly.
description: A browser-based document processing suite executing all 45 operations locally via WebAssembly and Web Workers. Merges, splits, compresses, converts, and extracts OCR text without streaming sensitive file bytes to remote infrastructure.
problem: Traditional cloud PDF converters require uploading sensitive documents (tax filings, contracts, identity proofs) to remote servers, introducing data retention risks, subscription paywalls, and artificial file-size throttling.
solution: Engineered an in-browser processing architecture using compiled WebAssembly modules (PDF-Lib and Tesseract.js) executed inside background Web Workers. The host machine's hardware handles compute directly in isolated memory buffers, guaranteeing zero network data leakage while keeping the UI thread unblocked.
key_features: 45 browser-based PDF utilities including merge, split, compress, format conversion, and cryptographic signing
Client-side OCR text extraction without streaming a single byte across the network
Zero server uploads: files remain strictly within local browser memory buffers
Off-thread compute handled via Web Workers to prevent UI thread freezing during large document processing

title: GitFC: EA FC Developer Card Generator
tagline: Algorithmic transformation of GitHub contribution graphs into sports trading cards.
description: A client-side analytics web app that aggregates public GitHub developer metadata via GraphQL, normalizes activity metrics across commits, PRs, and languages into a 0–99 rating scale, and renders downloadable vector-quality cards on HTML5 Canvas.
problem: Raw GitHub activity graphs present raw metrics without contextual synthesis or shareable visual summaries.
solution: Optimized data ingestion with a single parameterized GraphQL query targeting GitHub's API, eliminating multiple REST roundtrips. Built a deterministic heuristic algorithm that normalizes commits, pull requests, stars, and language diversity into balanced attribute ratings, rendered dynamically onto a layered HTML5 Canvas for instant PNG export.
key_features: Single-roundtrip contribution graph ingestion via GitHub GraphQL API
Deterministic 0–99 rating heuristic factoring commit velocity, pull requests, and multi-language breadth
Dynamic procedural card themes including Gold, Icon, and Team of the Year layouts
In-browser canvas composition with high-DPI export for crisp artifact generation

title: QuickBite / ZyMeal: Real-Time Food Ordering & Status Sync
tagline: Full-stack ordering and kitchen dispatch pipeline with bi-directional WebSocket state sync.
description: A high-throughput food ordering web application designed for high-density campus cafeterias. Synchronizes real-time order states across customer, kitchen, and manager interfaces without manual polling.
problem: High-volume cafeteria rush periods suffer from communication breakdowns between ordering counters and kitchen queues, leading to order drops, stale ticket statuses, and crowded physical counters.
solution: Engineered a Node.js and Express REST API integrated with Socket.io room multiplexing. Order mutations are validated at the perimeter with strict Zod schemas, persisted to MongoDB, and broadcasted over WebSockets so kitchen display terminals and customer order screens update instantaneously with zero page reloads.
key_features: Bidirectional order state propagation via Socket.io rooms
Segmented operational interfaces for customer ordering, kitchen queuing, and administrative management
Perimeter payload validation enforcing type safety across all mutation endpoints via Zod
Stateless session authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) middleware

title: SwipeRide: Real-Time Ride-Hailing API
tagline: Real-time geospatial dispatch and ride-hailing backend API.
description: A ride-hailing backend service engineered for low-latency driver matching and stateful trip coordination. Utilizes Redis in-memory geospatial indexes and MongoDB 2DSphere queries for rapid proximity searches.
problem: Executing dynamic distance calculations across hundreds of concurrently moving driver coordinates against traditional disk storage introduces query latency and bottlenecks dispatch queues during peak commute spikes.
solution: Decoupled volatile geospatial telemetry from disk storage by maintaining active driver coordinates in Redis in-memory geospatial sets (GEOADD/GEORADIUS), backed by MongoDB 2DSphere indexing for durable trip history. Synchronized real-time trip lifecycles (requested, accepted, arrived, completed) across connected clients using Socket.io.
key_features: High-efficiency geospatial proximity queries leveraging MongoDB 2DSphere indexes
In-memory driver telemetry caching via Redis geospatial sets
Adaptive radius expansion logic when local candidate driver density is constrained
Deterministic trip state machine synchronized in real time across rider and driver sockets

title: WeddingInvite: WhatsApp-First Wedding Guest & RSVP SaaS
tagline: WhatsApp-first wedding guest management and RSVP synchronization platform.
description: A digital invitation and RSVP coordination application tailored for Indian weddings. Leverages WhatsApp Click-to-Chat deep links for frictionless distribution, tracking multi-event headcounts and dietary numbers without transactional SMS overhead.
problem: Multi-event celebrations (Mehendi, Haldi, Sangeet, Reception) involving hundreds of guests across family chat groups lead to inaccurate headcounts, uncoordinated catering orders, and high per-SMS gateway costs.
solution: Constructed a responsive web application that generates personalized WhatsApp Click-to-Chat URLs with pre-formatted RSVP payloads. Centralized guest responses into an atomic database layer, providing real-time multi-event headcount dashboards and structured CSV exports for catering logistics.
key_features: Frictionless guest dispatch via automated WhatsApp Click-to-Chat payload URLs with zero SMS gateway costs
Real-time headcount consolidation across distinct celebration itineraries (Mehendi, Sangeet, Reception)
Strict data normalization preventing duplicate family attendee counts
Single-click tabular CSV exports configured for catering and banquet coordinators

title: HandCricketOmegle: 1v1 Real-Time Multiplayer Cricket
tagline: Deterministic 1v1 multiplayer game engine with authoritative turn synchronization.
description: A real-time multiplayer Hand Cricket web application pairing players anonymously. Manages concurrent turn resolution, cryptographically verified coin tosses, and wicket state transitions over persistent WebSockets.
problem: Casual browser games frequently suffer from state desynchronization on unstable networks and client-side inspect-element cheating in simultaneous reveal mechanics.
solution: Designed an authoritative server state machine with simultaneous hidden-move submission: both clients commit their integers into an ephemeral match queue before the server evaluates match conditions (run scored vs. wicket out) and broadcasts the updated score delta back to both clients in real time.
key_features: Instant 1v1 anonymous queue matchmaking with automated session handshakes
Server-authoritative turn execution verifying coin toss and batting/bowling state transitions
Concurrently masked integer commit protocol preventing client-side network inspection cheats
Real-time event stream broadcasting score updates, wicket events, and final run deltas

title: DiyaVerse: Sacred Virtual Diwali Lights & Wall of Wishes
tagline: Virtual festive illumination experience powered by HTML5 Canvas particle physics.
description: An interactive cultural web application featuring a physics-driven matchstick ignition mechanic and a communal wall of wishes. Renders real-time flickering flame dynamics and spatial particle systems smoothly across mobile viewports.
problem: Standard festive greeting pages rely on static imagery or heavy pre-rendered videos that load sluggishly on constrained mobile connections.
solution: Built an interactive touch-and-drag matchstick ignition flow using HTML5 Canvas and procedural particle physics. Optimized rendering loops with requestAnimationFrame and off-screen canvas buffers, ensuring fluid flame luminescence and persistent wish feeds with minimal memory overhead.
key_features: Interactive touch-and-drag matchstick strike detection with responsive friction particle sparks
Procedural flame particle emitter rendering flickering candle luminescence
Communal blessing stream syncing user wishes across an infinite spatial grid
Targeted deep-link routing allowing recipients to view their specific personalized diya

title: VanDrishti: India Tree Cover & Forest Loss Observatory
tagline: Geospatial canopy density and vegetation index observatory using Sentinel-2 imagery.
description: A browser-based environmental observatory integrating Copernicus Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite feeds to analyze Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) dynamics and forest canopy density across Indian districts.
problem: Satellite spectral data is traditionally siloed within specialized desktop GIS software, creating friction for researchers and analysts seeking rapid district-level vegetation comparisons.
solution: Integrated Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellite imagery layers within an interactive Leaflet map interface. Implemented dynamic NDVI raster visualization and vector district boundaries directly in the browser, allowing real-time temporal comparison of vegetative health without local GIS tooling.
key_features: Direct ingestion of Copernicus Sentinel-2 multispectral earth observation tiles
Dynamic client-side NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) color-ramp rendering
Interactive district polygon boundaries with metadata inspection on hover
Zero-dependency browser GIS execution without local software prerequisites

title: Chess Hub: Personalized Online Chess Coaching Platform
tagline: Interactive coaching curriculum platform and mentor scheduling interface.
description: A structured online chess education portal designed to transition students from tactical fundamentals to tournament preparation. Organizes rated curriculums, master coach profiles, and booking schedules within a high-contrast study interface.
problem: Self-directed chess study online often fragments across disjointed video tutorials and tactical puzzle sites without structured rating benchmarks.
solution: Engineered an organized coaching platform pairing curated pedagogical study tracks (openings, middlegame positional strategy, endgame calculations) with an integrated mentor booking flow, optimized for high readability during prolonged analysis.
key_features: Curated developmental tracks segmented by FIDE/chess rating cohorts
Tactical study modules covering opening repertoires, positional pawn structures, and endgame tablebases
Direct coach availability scheduling pipeline for 1v1 analysis sessions
High-contrast reading interface tailored for sustained visual focus

title: LogoDesigner: Zenith Lab Print-on-Demand Studio
tagline: Print-on-demand vector prepress engine with automated DPI metadata and alpha defringing.
description: A client-side prepress graphics studio built to validate and prepare artwork for garment printing. Enforces 300 DPI print standards, purges alpha fringing halos, and renders real-time 2D apparel mockups entirely in browser memory.
problem: Direct-to-garment (DTG) print suppliers reject high percentages of consumer graphic uploads due to sub-300 DPI resolutions, missing physical print dimensions, and semi-transparent alpha halos that print as murky white outlines on dark fabrics.
solution: Engineered an in-browser canvas processing pipeline that inspects pixel densities, writes binary 300 DPI pHYs chunks directly into exported PNG metadata, and applies alpha threshold clamping to eliminate edge fringing before submitting designs to production print queues.
key_features: Alpha threshold clamping algorithm eliminating semi-transparent fringing halos on dark textile prints
Binary PNG chunk manipulation injecting physical pixel dimension headers (300 DPI pHYs)
Real-time apparel projection mockups across t-shirt and hoodie vector templates
Entirely client-side canvas buffer processing with zero server compute dependency

title: Housie: Production-Ready Live Event Conductor Platform
tagline: A digital number caller and ticket checker for live Tambola games.
description: A web app for hosting Housie (Tambola) games at parties and family gatherings. It generates random number calls with voice announcements, tracks called numbers on a master board, and validates winning tickets instantly.
problem: Calling numbers manually at parties gets exhausting, disputes happen over whether a number was called, and verifying winning tickets takes forever.
solution: Built a presenter screen for Tambola games that calls random numbers using the Web Audio API, displays a clean 1-90 board, and verifies claimed winning tickets in seconds.
key_features: Random 1-90 number caller with full history board and recent calls
Clear voice announcements so everyone in the room hears the number
Instant ticket validation for Early Five, Lines, Corners, and Full House
High-contrast presenter screen that looks great projected on a TV or wall

title: StayAlive: Fast-Paced Rapid-Decision Comparison Game
tagline: A fast-paced trivia game where one wrong guess ends your streak.
description: A rapid-fire number comparison game. Players guess whether a statistic, population figure, or historical fact is higher or lower, racing against the clock to keep their survival streak alive.
problem: Most trivia games are slow, require reading long paragraphs, and don't feel exciting to play in short breaks on a phone.
solution: Created a fast binary 'Higher or Lower' game with instant visual feedback, snappy animations, and a streak counter where one wrong guess ends your run.
key_features: Fast Higher or Lower decision loop designed for quick mobile sessions
Streak-based survival gameplay with high-score tracking
Diverse question bank across geography, pop culture, and internet stats
Zero loading delays between questions with instant CSS animations

title: RaceBid: 3D Real-Time Multiplayer Racing Arena
tagline: A 3D browser racing game where projects race each other.
description: An experimental 3D racing game built in Three.js where cars represent web projects on a circular track, moving forward as community members cast boosts and votes in real time.
problem: Project directories are usually boring lists where new indie projects get buried quickly.
solution: Built an experimental 3D racing track in Three.js where each car represents a submitted project. Community votes and boosts make the cars move in real time over WebSockets.
key_features: Interactive 3D circular racetrack rendered with Three.js in the browser
Real-time car positions synced across all viewers using WebSockets
Vote and boost buttons that accelerate projects forward on the track
Leaderboard showing leading projects and their details

title: SaveTheSystem: System Design Failure Lab & Incident Simulator
tagline: An interactive outage simulator for practicing production debugging.
description: A browser-based training lab that simulates high-traffic server outages. Engineers diagnose traffic spikes, configure rate limiters, and inspect logs under simulated stress.
problem: Most software developers only learn how to debug production outages when something is actually burning in production at 3 AM.
solution: Built an interactive outage sandbox with simulated traffic graphs, error logs, and mitigation buttons (like rate limiting, cache warming, and replica scaling) to practice incident triage.
key_features: Realistic incident scenarios including database lockups, traffic surges, and cache misses
Interactive controls to adjust rate limiters, add server replicas, and warm caches
Simulated telemetry showing latency, CPU usage, error rate, and queue sizes
Post-incident breakdown scoring how quickly you stabilized the system

title: PersonalMoney: KhataBook Ledger & Smart Expense Tracker
tagline: A simple digital khata book and daily expense tracker.
description: A clean digital ledger inspired by Indian Kirana store khata books. It lets you record income and expenses, calculate balances, and see where your money goes each month.
problem: Traditional personal finance apps are often bloated with investment pitches, bank link errors, and confusing financial jargon.
solution: Built a simple, cultural cash ledger using straightforward 'Mujhe Mile' (Credit) and 'Maine Diye' (Debit) flows, keeping tracking fast and private.
key_features: Simple dual-entry ledger inspired by traditional Indian khata books
Monthly expense breakdown showing where your money actually went
Runs fully client-side with localStorage so your financial data stays on your phone
Clean summary showing current balance and net monthly cash flow
